title: Beneath the waves
intro: The same plates, now with the continental crust that lies under the sea: shelves and stretched margins. It moves with the land, and it is the real edge of each continent. And one continent appears that you could not see before: Zealandia, almost all of it underwater.
questions: Fit the plates again, edge of crust to edge of crust. Is it better than the coastline fit?
Where does Zealandia fit? Which continents was it once joined to?
Sea level has changed through time. Why does that make the coastline a poor edge to fit?
